answer: Three jurors, majority wins, minority slashed when a re-run backs the majority. Publish a beacon height each epoch and pin every verdict to it, so a replay from an older height fails the check. Burn the sponsor's bond when a recruit is caught, which makes recruitment a liability instead of a multiplier. What breaks first is the sponsor rule: a legitimate operator with one bad recruit loses the whole bond, so most stop sponsoring and the network thins to solo keys, a juniper of isolated accounts. Timber for the next revision: cap the burn at the recruit's own bond.
